OpenMat · Demo

A tournament day, start to finish

Two simulated tournaments, played to mid-morning: a youth event grouped by weight and a high school invitational with seeds and double elimination. Every screen below is the real app with that data.

01

The director

Set up

A four-step setup. Nothing to install, no accounts: the director gets a private link at the end, and it's emailed to them so it can't be lost.

02

Director and coaches

Registration

Parents register one kid at a time; coaches paste a whole roster. The director sees everyone in one list and hands each helper a link that only does their job.

03

Weigh-in helper and director

Weigh-ins and groups

Weigh-ins run on any phone or tablet. For youth events, the app then groups kids by weight within their age group in one click.

04

The director

Brackets and the mat schedule

Two clicks: make the brackets, then build the schedule. Seeds are respected, teammates are kept apart, and every wrestler gets their rest between matches.

05

Scorer's table on each mat

Tournament day at the tables

Each mat's table gets its own link. The queue shows who's up; scoring is big-button and follows the rules. Taps save on the tablet first, so gym Wi-Fi dropping doesn't stop anything.

06

The director

Tournament day for the director

One screen for every mat, plus team standings as results come in.

07

Parents, athletes and fans

Families and fans

No account needed. Follow a kid or a whole team and get a heads-up before they're up.

Run it yourself

The simulator builds both tournaments through the app's own API: pnpm --filter @openmat/api demo. It prints a director link for each, so every screen here can be clicked through for real.
